title: Quick Smoky Thai Red Snapper Noodles
description: A salty, silky, energizing northern Thai dish featuring smoked red snapper, silky rice noodles, and aromatic sauces, all finished in a cast‑iron skillet.
instructions: Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium heat and add 1 tsp oil, then sauté crushed smoked paprika and smoked sea salt until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking until aromatic, about 1 minute.
Pour in fish stock, fish sauce, and lime juice, and stir to combine, bringing to a gentle simmer.
Add palm sugar and stir until dissolved, then reduce heat to low and let the sauce thicken slightly, about 3 minutes.
Toss in the pre-soaked noodles, stirring to coat them evenly with the smoky sauce, cooking for 2 minutes.
Slide the red snapper fillets into the skillet, cover, and cook for 4-5 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the skillet from heat and stir in chopped cilantro and sliced chili, adjusting seasoning with extra fish sauce or salt if needed.
Ladle the noodles and fish onto a serving plate, ensuring the sauce is distributed.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds if desired for added texture.
Serve immediately, optionally squeezing a splash of fresh lime over the top for brightness.
